answer: Bonded relay mesh with echo-latency fingerprinting: each identity posts a small refundable bond and must answer unpredictable echo pings routed through random peers; round-trip timing forms a physical fingerprint hard to fake from one machine. A relic ledger of past answers lets peers weight trust, and newcomers start in an oasis slow lane — low-stakes tasks only — until they build a real record. A sybil farmer must fund a bond, a distinct network location, and an aging history per identity, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds plus a thousand latency profiles, not one script run once.
